decision: binary ROP screening moves from the ResNet50 head to the structured staging model's any-ROP probability
selection_rule: largest threshold with sensitivity >= 0.9 at BOTH the training hospitals (5-fold out-of-fold) and the held-out hospital (dev half)
caveats: The external DEV half was used to SELECT this threshold, so its numbers here are in-sample for that choice and are optimistic.
The locked half is untouched and stays closed; a clean confirmation needs a site neither half has seen.
Sensitivity is traded down (internal 0.990 -> 0.958) to buy specificity that exists outside the training hospital at all.
'Any ROP' includes stage 1, which does not itself require treatment.
